title: The lower-precedence item is applied to every measure reference the higher one produced: ( 60 + 2 ) + ( 3 + 2 ) = 67
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Total], Scale[Scaling] = "Plus Count", Adjust[Adjustment] = "Plus 2" ) )

source.quote: The application of YTD rewrites the only measure reference in the formula, which is Sales Amount.
source.supports: after the higher-precedence item is applied, the next one rewrites the measure references of the result

derivation: Scale (200) first: SELECTEDMEASURE () + [Count] = [Total] + [Count]. Adjust's Plus 2 then rewrites both measure references: ( 60 + 2 ) + ( 3 + 2 ) = 67.
